bagPolicy.summary: The venue rules allow clear plastic or vinyl bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Backpacks and oversized bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Accessible parking is on the north side of Littlejohn Coliseum along Ravenel Road and in the north circle lot. The venue rules do not list general concert lots.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off location on its venue rules page.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands are on the Coliseum concourse and accessible from any portal.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is on Ravenel Road and at the north circle lot; four family restrooms are listed around the concourse. A wellness room for nursing mothers is near Sections 111/211.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue states that a patron who exits cannot re-enter except with an unscanned ticket.

ticketPickup.summary: For basketball games, will call is at the Burton Gallery Box Office near Perimeter Road and opens 90 minutes before tip-off. The page does not specify concert will-call times.

gates.summary: For basketball games, the student and club entrances open 90 minutes before tip-off and other doors open 60 minutes before tip-off. The page does not specify concert door times.
